payload.title: Outlier Detection with Pyleoclim
payload.description: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates outlier detection using clustering algorithms in the Pyleoclim library. It focuses on two main algorithms: k-means and DBSCAN, explaining their application and the diagnostic metrics they return. The notebook uses a dataset in LiPD format to illustrate the process of detecting outliers in paleoclimate data. It provides insights into parameter selection and the differences between the algorithms, offering a comprehensive guide to applying these techniques in unsupervised machine learning contexts.
